annotations.title: MPS Order No. 172 Mutual Recognition & Permit vs 6-Year License Evaluator

description: Determine whether an overseas driver qualifies for a zero-exam bilateral swap across 6 treaty jurisdictions, a 15-minute airport tourist permit, or a 6-year C1/C2 conversion.

applicantAge.description: Driver age in years; checks C1/C2 zero upper age ceiling and age 70+ cognitive Three Abilities test under Order No. 172.

holdsChinaResidencePermit.description: Whether the applicant holds a Chinese Work, Study, or Family Residence Permit valid for 90+ days.

issuingJurisdiction.description: Country or SAR issuing the current valid foreign license (e.g., "France", "Belgium", "UAE", "Serbia", "Hong Kong", "Macau", "USA", "UK").

stayDurationDays.description: Planned stay duration in Mainland China measured in days (temporary permit covers up to 90 days per entry).
